# CityMETER · Hotel

> Recorded hotel rooms and accommodation records across Thailand by district (เขต/อำเภอ), with straight-line distance to rail stations (CityMETER Transit) and retail venues (CityMETER Shopping centers), hotel groups, recorded prices and a comparison set per hotel. A Landometer CityMETER public demo, release 0.1.0 (2026-11-01). Research master checked 2026-10-25.

What one figure means:
- rooms = Σ rooms_selected, the room count the sources record. Not rooms available per night, occupancy, demand, ADR or revenue. Unknown rooms are counted apart, never as 0.
- records (แห่ง) = source-listed accommodation records (CityMETER Hotel V3, TAT accommodation register, official group and property pages, provincial lists). Operation is not revalidated; not a census.
- recorded prices = min/max/avg THB recorded by CityMETER Hotel V3, source period unknown. Per hotel only.
- distances = straight lines between reference points, not walking routes or catchments.
- districts = CityMETER production districts (codes as in https://landometer.com/v3/citymeter/{province}/D/{district}?d=hotel).

Snapshot (release 0.1.0, fixtures, recompute from data):
- 30,729 records, 996,784 rooms recorded (30,477 records with known rooms), 860 of 928 districts, 77 provinces.
- Bangkok: 34% of rooms placed at district level (44,897 of 130,608) are in Khlong Toei, Ratchathewi and Watthana; 65% of their rooms with a point lie within 500 m of an operating rail station, against 38% in the rest of Bangkok.
- The district with the most rooms recorded: Bang Lamung, Chon Buri (61,480).

Deep links (https://montri-th.github.io/hotel/):
- ?metric=count — measure records instead of rooms
- ?province={code} — e.g. BKK, PKT, CBI (production codes)
- ?area={district code} — e.g. 1039 (เขตวัฒนา)
- ?areas={code},{code} | ?areas=all — focus districts / every district
- ?group={hotel|resort|apartment|guesthouse|bungalow|homestay|other} · ?size={s1…s6} · ?chain={group id | none}
- ?hotel={record id} · ?station={CityMETER Transit station id} · ?view={areas|mix|chains} · ?search={text}

Data and method:
- [Product statement](https://montri-th.github.io/hotel/PRODUCT_STATEMENT.md): users, problem, claim boundary
- [Data and method](https://montri-th.github.io/hotel/DATA_METHOD.md): sources, measures, district matching, context joins, limits
- [Dataset](https://montri-th.github.io/hotel/data/hotels.json): columnar rows + dictionaries + provenance (meta)
- [Developer handoff](https://montri-th.github.io/hotel/handoff/START_HERE.md)

Do not claim from this data: occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, revenue, demand, market share, current prices, that a hotel is open today, star ratings, walking time, or that a district without records has no hotels.
